articles.summary: MIAMI, Sept. 16, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- International Money Express, Inc. (NASDAQ: IMXI) (“Intermex” or the “Company”), a leading money remittance provider to Latin America and the Caribbean, today announced the expansion of its Payroll Card Program in partnership with Central Payments.
articles.title: Intermex Payroll Mastercard Program Now Offers No-Fee International Wires Through Mobile App and Web
